definition.name: image_column_fit
definition.description: Explicit optional S2 count-model observation on one saved spatial scalar plane. Preserve raw fixed 5x5 ROI means separately from fitted full 5x5 means (background and neighbours included) and central-column integrals extrapolated to the whole plane by a unit-integral Gaussian. At most9 fixed 9x9 patch fits use supplied geometry/common sigma, pixel-integrated isotropic Gaussians and four nonnegative bilinear backgrounds. Columns are fitted jointly within each patch, not a global independent target/reference likelihood. Missing geometry or unsupported count interpretation saves raw evidence plus UNKNOWN, never inferred counts from dtype. Every requested reference must qualify for an overall contrast; no dropped failures, confidence interval, occupancy or defect/phase classification. Read/recover/export saved results without optimizer replay; no Panel or AnalysisContext slot is added.

rect.description: Fixed primary 5x5 readout, half-open source-pixel edges [x0,y0,x1,y1]. Worker checks exact size and surrounding 9x9 fit support without clipping.

items.description: Half-open source pixel edges [x0,y0,x1,y1], no clipping.

reference_rects.description: Distinct same-image fixed 5x5 references, in the same order as geometry.site_centers_xy after the primary.

source_text.description: Actual reference-selection source and same-class assumption. Equivalence and independence remain unverified.

site_centers_xy.description: Fixed source-pixel column centres [X,Y], primary first then each reference in reference_rects order. Caller-supplied and unverified; no centre fitting or bright-peak recentering.

supplied_columns_xy.description: All supplied column centres on this exact source grid, including the requested sites. Duplicate/excessive geometry is refused before fitting; neighbours are selected by integrated support mass >=0.005, never a centre-distance prefilter.

sigma_pixels.description: One supplied isotropic Gaussian sigma in source pixels for every column. Fixed during fitting; not a physical resolution or a verified peak shape.

source_text.description: Actual source and assumptions for the fixed geometry and common width; caller reported, not authenticated.

model.description: Caller noise/count interpretation. independent_poisson_counts is the narrow supported model; other explicit models are retained with UNKNOWN_UNSUPPORTED_NOISE.

source_text.description: Actual source of the count/noise interpretation, including acquisition or calibration explanation. Integer dtype alone is insufficient; no implicit gain, exposure or intensity conversion.

request_id.description: Save this ID before submission; query image_result after timeout/cancellation. Reusing it with different parameters is rejected.

definition.name: image_discovery_review
definition.description: Bind existing numerical evidence to one exact saved ROI. Also accepts saved spatial raw statistics with primary ROI equal to candidate (comparison references remain contextual), or a width-one profile wholly inside it (line subset only); reconstructs these from original arrays/requests. Optional site_context selects attached reference statistics and a fixed expected position: saves every raw reference difference, reference sign disagreement, unknown physical causes and a suggested next step. This is neither localization nor significance; declared modality/count meaning is not verified and S2 is never dispatched. Probe is ephemeral, not saved review evidence. Manual image-first is supported within the documented synthetic software/numerical scope; automatic proposals remain EXPERIMENTAL. Check source/frame/ROI/current calibration, journals and payloads; retain hypotheses and unknowns, never confirmed defects/twins/phases. FFT/peaks/measurement/GPA tools perform science explicitly; qualified GPA may hand off to F4. image_export on this review saves report JSON, existing candidate-review text, available PNG and provenance; export each GPA separately for amplitude/masks. No new FFT/GPA, saved measurement or hidden model call.

expected_position_xy.description: Fixed expected source-pixel X,Y inside this candidate; caller prior, not a detected position. Never snapped to a maximum.

signal_source_text.description: Actual source of channel and processing/count meaning. These are unverified declarations; derived iDPC is not independent Poisson counts.

include_site_continuation.description: Opt in to a source-bound existing-tool handoff and linked review template. Requires site_context; no tool is dispatched. The host must inspect the saved original outcome and append a known completed profile before the linked review. Omission preserves historical output.

hypothesis.description: Caller free text retained without parsing or testing. Numerical support/opposition is limited to net image-phase closure on the specified circuits, not arbitrary hypotheses, material displacement or real dislocations.

relation.description: Caller-supplied relation to the hypothesis, never an authenticated or automatically measured physical conclusion.

anchors_xy.description: Explicit anchors inside the exact candidate ROI, in original source pixels; no automatic tracing.

candidate_assessment.description: Opt-in source-bound four-way report: supports/opposes/unknown/next tools. Requires exactly one saved topology and one projected_topology method plan in evidence_ids, identical GPA inputs, explicit paths and model. Real-space input is caller supplied; synthetic truth is not independent specimen evidence. Review dispatches no science and never confirms a material dislocation.

request_id.description: Save before submission; recover through image_result using this original ID after cancellation or timeout. Unknown operations are never automatically replayed.

source.scope: Already integrated explicit site and candidate interfaces; no runtime changes in this fix
